fl_tests_deid.parquet.grain: one row per subject breath test (one STED page)

columns.sample1: Subject Sample #1 BrAC g/210L (valid reading; NaN if none)
columns.sample2: Subject Sample #2 BrAC g/210L (valid reading; NaN if none)
columns.refusal_flag: Subject Test Refused present on page
columns.volume_not_met_flag: Volume Not Met present on page
columns.instrument_pseudonym: random integer per instrument serial (seed discarded; raw serial NOT stored)
columns.n_valid_samples: count of valid subject-sample readings on the page
